name: bundle-01
title: Bundle 01 - A Selection Of Things With Quantities And What They Come To
description: A selection of things with a mark, a name, a description, a quantity stepper, a unit price, a line total and a remove control, over a required breakdown and a total that is a prop rather than a number the Block derived. The stepper is the number field Component and the remove control is a real button, because a div with a handler is not reachable by a keyboard. Client Component, because onQuantityChange and onRemove are functions.
